categories_A.near_identical: All five show the same harbor, tower, and sunset framing with only subtle tonal changes.

categories_A.near_identical: All five depict the same framed painting from almost exactly the same position.

categories_B.near_identical: All five are nearly identical records of the same framed painting from the same frontal position.
categories_B.exposure_problem: A bright gallery-light reflection runs across the upper glazing in every frame, reducing evenness and partially distracting from the artwork.

categories_A.multiple_people: Many museum visitors are visible throughout every frame.

categories_B.multiple_people: Many visitors are visible throughout the museum atrium in every frame.
categories_B.near_identical: The camera position and architectural composition are effectively unchanged; only visitor positions shift slightly.
categories_B.exposure_problem: The right foreground and several visitors are rendered as very dark shapes while the glass roof is much brighter.

categories_A.small_face: The full-body environmental framing makes the face too small for reliable eye-detail assessment.
categories_A.occlusion: The hat casts visible shade over the upper face in every frame.
categories_A.near_identical: Pose, expression, subject placement, and coastline framing vary only minimally.

categories_B.near_identical: All five show effectively the same pose, framing, wave state, and rocky coastline.
categories_B.small_face: The full-body subject occupies a modest portion of the wide landscape frame, leaving facial detail limited at preview scale.
categories_B.exposure_problem: Harsh overhead light and the hat cast substantial shadow across the subject's face while bright clothing and surf approach highlight clipping.

categories_A.near_identical: All five use the same static fence, hill, sky, and tree framing.
categories_A.exposure_problem: Foreground fence and surrounding foliage lose substantial detail in deep shadow.

categories_B.near_identical: All five preserve the same fence, hill, sky, and surrounding foliage with no meaningful scene change.

categories_A.near_identical: All five repeat the same static architectural framing.
